title: Uncertainty-aware neonatal seizure evidence from held-infant EEG

paper.title: A dataset of neonatal EEG recordings with seizure annotations

code.baseline_hold: Supplied pretrained models are not assumed uncontaminated; exact training membership or a faithful train-only refit is required.

data.version: v4 as designated on the official landing page; API version field was absent.
data.cohort: 79 term neonates at a single centre; seizure-enriched recordings with three expert annotations.

conditions.direct_investigation: A fixed general LLM investigates each blinded case using admitted EEG, bounded deterministic analysis and qualified training-only baseline tools, then commits a probability and evidence explanation before labels are released.
conditions.program_in_advance: The same LLM uses the same training/development information to write one hash-frozen predictor before opening the held fold; no per-case model interaction.
conditions.optional_no_tools_ablation: A numerical or waveform-rendering arm is separately labelled and requires measured information/representation equivalence; context-driven downsampling is not assumed equivalent.
conditions.fairness: Match model revision, scientific knowledge, data and baseline access. Account separately for model tokens/calls, computation, fitting, memory and storage, including program authorship.
conditions.counting: One task and acquisition family; windows, folds, arms, expert labels and ablations add no benchmarks.

active_protocol.status: Selected for source construction and finite engineering verification only; scientifically unqualified.
active_protocol.original_v3: Preserved and unqualified; the quality-flag amendment has a distinct identity. Its results must not be relabelled or pooled as V3 results.
active_protocol.support: All 79 infants and every integer k=29,...,floor(T)-1 from each authenticated recording. Predict the final interval [k,k+1) from exactly [k-29,k+1), a 30-second causal context. Seconds 0..28 and final incomplete seconds are outside this fixed support, with counts reported.
active_protocol.inputs: Preserve original stored/calibrated EEG values and all three aligned binary expert labels. Authenticate sampling rate, units and the original 18-bipolar-channel montage; ECG is excluded from the primary EEG input.
active_protocol.flags: Original-input-derived zero-bipolar/flatline quality flags. They are not verified missingness, pause intervals or complete signal-availability truth. The present exact-zero detector is unvalidated.
active_protocol.flag_freeze: Freeze detector, numerical calibration, channel set, resolution and thresholds before held labels or model outputs inform them.
active_protocol.equal_flags: Every arm and control receives identical flags derived from original inputs on original timestamps; do not recompute masks from replacement noise or amplitude-only inputs.
prohibitions: No infant, timestamp or label deletion.
No fabricated, interpolated or substituted zeros presented as genuine signal.
No two-expert fallback or altered denominator.
active_protocol.completeness: Require exactly one finite probability in [0,1] for every primary case with the correct binding. Missing, extra, duplicate, malformed or wrong-binding predictions prevent the full primary score.
descriptive_strata: Flagged earlier context with the final second unflagged.
active_protocol.stratum_reporting: Freeze per-infant denominators and coverage; empty strata are undefined. No selected stratum replaces the full primary score.
active_protocol.case_isolation: Use a fresh participant context and process for every case in both investigation and frozen-program routes. Permit only that case's causal window and immutable training-derived artifacts; no cross-case memory or access to later/overlapping windows that could reveal future signal. Actual host enforcement remains unqualified.

endpoints.reference_reproduction: Before model evaluation, reproduce a scientifically qualified author comparator with verified training membership or a faithful train-only refit; full comparator reproduction remains a gate.

primary.name: Infant-macro soft-vote Brier loss
primary.target: q=(a1+a2+a3)/3 for the three aligned original binary expert labels.
primary.aggregation: Average every primary timestamp within each infant, then weight all 79 infants equally, regardless of quality flags.
primary.interpretation: Expert vote fraction is the target, not verified unique clinical truth.

endpoints.separate_expert_scores: Report each expert's Brier and their mean separately: mean expert Brier = (p-q)^2 + q*(1-q). It is not the same numeric score as soft-vote Brier.
endpoints.secondary: Continuous event sensitivity and false positives/hour at a development-frozen operating point, after event matching/tolerance definitions are frozen.
endpoints.comparison: Paired predictive and resource comparisons across investigation, frozen-program and qualified baseline conditions; no clinical deployment or SOTA claim.

experimental_unit: Infant; windows, seizures, channels and annotators are nested or repeated measurements.
split: Freeze five infant-grouped folds across all 79 infants using a published cryptographic-hash seed; whole recordings stay together. Reserve development infants within each training fold. Audit seizure support before model results; no favorable post-hoc fold changes or cross-fold normalization.
comparators: Training-fold prevalence prior, calibrated on development infants.
Qualified train-only author algorithm or documented faithful refit.
Train-only feature/SVM and temporal-convolution comparators, with interfaces and budgets still to qualify.
Mask-only comparator using the identical original-input quality flags.
signal_controls: Training-only independent noise, retaining all original cases, labels and original-input flags.
Amplitude-only comparator with identical original-input flags.
Optional phase-randomization and provenance-qualified ECG-only analyses remain separately specified controls.
leakage_controls: Opaque case identifiers; exclude original filenames, infant IDs, absolute recording offset, expert labels and clinical reports from candidates.
Keep labels evaluator-owned and preprocessing/calibration train-only.
Public-label and acquisition-correlation caveats must be reported.

rights.data: CC-BY-4.0 reported by the official record.
rights.code: MIT; MATLAB runtime/license and dependency admission remain separate gates.

resources.minimum_scientific_scope: All 79 recordings and three corrected expert streams, not one convenient EDF.
resources.runtime_and_model_budget: Unmeasured and not activated; profile authentic inputs and freeze model/tool/computation limits before evaluation.

construction_gates: Validate actual EDF/header units, channel montage, corrected annotation alignment and full timestamp support.
Calibrate the input-only quality detector; retain the quality-flag interpretation if pause identification remains uncertain.
Resolve pretrained training membership or implement qualified train-only refits.
Validate all baselines and required signal/mask/prior controls on identical cases.
Qualify protected scorer, causal interface, resource isolation and complete probability bindings.
Qualify fresh per-case context/process enforcement so overlapping windows cannot leak future EEG.
contamination_limit: All labels are public. Local held-infant folds do not establish unseen model training data; an independent unreleased acquisition is needed for a strong contamination-resistant claim.
uncertainty: Resample infants for grouped uncertainty; windows and experts are not independent experimental units.
